content.text: In Zimbabwe, like other countries under financial isolation, digital creators have been locked out of platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-building-crypto-store-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-2|Cloudflare Webhook-Driven]]-pages-complete-infrastructure-3|building]] a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure solution that grants sovereignty over digital commerce. With COREMERCH, you own [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-cloudflare-workers-crypto-4|COREMERCH guide to everything]] after deployment, no subscriptions, and no platform dependencies. This guide will walk you through deploying a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages using Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, and is deployed in 48 hours with end-to-end testing before handoff. The Sovereign Starter Stack and Sovereign Blueprint are also covered, but the focus is on Stack 02.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal are not only accessible to creators in countries with severe financial restrictions, but they also take a significant cut of the transaction fees. This is where Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments come in, offering a free hosting solution with automatic crypto payment processing, eliminating the need for a third-party payment processor. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy a fully operational online store in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff. This infrastructure works when platforms fail because it's built on a base-layer solution that grants sovereignty over digital commerce, eliminating the risk of platform shutdowns and giving you full control over your digital products and payments.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need a GitHub account, a Cloudflare account, and a NOWPayments account. You'll also need to familiarize yourself with the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Additionally, you'll need to have a digital product ready to sell, such as an ebook, course, or template. Make sure you have a clear understanding of your target audience and their preferred payment methods. It's also essential to have a good understanding of the Sovereign Blueprint and the Sovereign Starter Stack, as these will be crucial in deploying your crypto store successfully.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages store. This involves creating a new worker in Cloudflare Workers, which will handle the payment processing and delivery of your digital products. You'll also need to configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for your domain to ensure secure email delivery. With the Edge Commerce Stack, this process is simplified, and you'll have a fully functional payment and delivery pipeline in no time.
With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy a fully operational online store in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy your store in 48 hours, and with the Sovereign Starter Stack, you can deploy in 4-6 hours. Before going live, make sure you've tested your payment and delivery pipeline thoroughly to ensure a seamless experience for your customers. With NOWPayments, automatic on-chain crypto payment verification is guaranteed, eliminating the need for a third-party payment processor.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your crypto store is live and processing transactions, it's essential to scale your infrastructure to meet the growing demand. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can easily scale your store by adding more workers, increasing your storage, and configuring your delivery pipeline to handle more traffic. Additionally, you can use the Sovereign Blueprint to optimize your store's performance and ensure a seamless customer experience. With the Edge Commerce Stack, scaling is a breeze, and you can focus on growing your business without worrying about infrastructure complexities.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages using the Edge Commerce Stack, follow these steps: Create a new GitHub account and Cloudflare account, and set up a NOWPayments account. Familiarize yourself with the Edge Commerce Stack and the Sovereign Blueprint. Deploy a digital product, such as an ebook, course, or template. Set up your payment and delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for your domain. Test your payment and delivery pipeline thoroughly before going live. Deploy your store using the Edge Commerce Stack and test it thoroughly before handing it over to your customers. Scale your infrastructure as needed to meet growing demand.
